answer: Reaching eligibility takes 54 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. The ivory register is checked at draw time, jetty lists the eligible set, and mesa seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 54 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 362 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
